biggest_catch: Referrer earns a $50 FamilyPlus reward for each friend/family member who joins iTHINK Financial, paid to the referrer's membership account within 60 days; rewards for business, trust, or non-individual memberships do not qualify, and iTHINK employees are ineligible.
catches: Referral must be submitted before the referred member joins; submissions after the person already joined do not qualify
Reward is paid to the referring member's membership account within 60 days of the referred member joining
Referring member must be 18+ and have loans in good standing and deposit accounts with positive balances at bonus time
iTHINK Financial employees, spouses, and household members are not eligible for referral rewards
Only individual memberships qualify — business, trust, or other non-individual memberships do not
Referral bonuses may be reported as income to the IRS; taxes are the referrer's responsibility
Program may be canceled or changed at any time without notice; membership subject to qualification (FL/GA)
